name: Princess Tetsuko
source:
She became a princess before she knew it. 

To be accurate, she can't remember anything before that.

Sometimes she remembers some keywords like "Tetsuko" and "voice actress". 

She is from the kingdom of Rosemary.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/himebo/chara/chara.html]official site[/url]]
